$comment: THE CROWN. One voice at the Great Cairn, and it is the payoff of every waist-high heap of stones the player has walked past since the gate four miles below. He does not tell them to add one. Being told to would ruin it.

lines: Your friend put one on. Went round the whole thing twice first, looking for a gap.
There is no gap. He found that funny. He was not laughing at it, mind.
Nine hundred and six years, one stone at a time, carried up from the gate.
People ask me how many. I tell them nobody knows and they always look disappointed.
It is better that nobody knows. Work it out.
